title: First-person moves: vanilla vs bigger arms
desc: First-person arms for the 11 moves the 519 catalogue showed had none (flurries, slams, slide, take-off, double jumps, lantern sprint, arm-lead flight), each in a vanilla-size and a 1.3x bigger style; J asked "Show me both".
superseded_by: skipped by J 2026-10-18 (pose file missing; renders kept failing)

takes.facts: guard; left jab at 6, ring cross at 11, ring arm winds across the chest and backfists out to the right at 18; dummy target; Minecraft's own first-person arm size; camera rides the eyes of 3rd-person take F2 (507); 61 ticks
